ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah. He really could play that. I was going to play any tune in the band play. It used to take so long. Yeah. Tried the foot of one foot. Just playing the devil out of that whistle. And I used to wonder how he used to get up when I could play it down low. But to get up, you know. He used to go up like you go up on a horn. Teep. Do-do-dee-do-do-do-do. All like that. I couldn't do it.
I think you'd blow hard to do that or something.
